entry.title: fix(deps): 显式声明 expo-router 必需 peer 依赖，修复 Metro 打包失败
entry.content:
fix(deps): 显式声明 expo-router 必需 peer 依赖，修复 Metro 打包失败

根因：安装全程用 --legacy-peer-deps（因锁文件里 react@19.2.3 与 react-dom@19.2.8
历史版本不匹配，不带该 flag 会 ERESOLVE 中止），而该 flag 会完全跳过 peerDependencies，
使 expo-router 的原生必需 peer 被 npm 当成多余包剪掉，Metro 报
"Unable to resolve react-native-safe-area-context"。

修法：把 expo-router 的原生必需 peer 在 package.json 显式声明——
react-native-safe-area-context ~5.9.1 / react-native-screens ~4.27.0 /
expo-linking ~57.0.9 / expo-constants ~57.0.17。显式依赖不受 --legacy-peer-deps 影响。

验证：npm ls 树上版本正确；tsc --noEmit 零错误；npx expo export --platform android
成功打包 1278 模块（entry hbc 2.9MB）。README 补「依赖说明」记录该坑与三步验证法。

entry.title: feat(M3.2): Chinese example translations + v4 whole-DB swap; fix stat…
entry.content:
feat(M3.2): Chinese example translations + v4 whole-DB swap; fix stats live update & card-back scroll

- build_examples.py: with links.tar.bz2 fully downloaded, rebuild examples with EN->ZH
  pairing (user_version 3->4). 111,655 example rows, 26,625 words, 8,779 rows have
  Chinese translation (~7.9%); asset db 22.0MB.
- Database.ts: EXPECTED_DB_VERSION 3->4 so returning users' runtime db re-copies the
  new asset (whole-DB swap, resets progress per existing design) and gets Chinese examples.
- stats.tsx: add useFocusEffect to re-read today's counts on tab focus (was stale on
  first render; tab switch doesn't remount so it never updated after learning).
- ReviewCard.tsx: fix card-back scroll - back face now renders AFTER the flip layer
  (higher z-index) with pointerEvents toggled by flipped; swipes now scroll instead of
  being misread as a flip. Tap (no scroll) still flips back.
- README: document Chinese examples, v4 swap, stats fix, and corrected scroll fix.
